title: Failure in an estimate trace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let a trace be a finite list of estimate records of length $n$, let the target be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $	au$ be a rational threshold in $(0,1]$. The trace has a failure if it contains a record that is not accurate for this target at threshold $	au$.
